_comment: Scenario registry: driver file scenarios/<name>.luau, the schema (per-library definitions live in adapters/<adapter>/), and frames_scale, a multiplier on --frames so cheap scenarios run long enough for stable timings.

scenarios.name: club_tick
scenarios.desc: 50 players x 300-card private club; Cash changes for everyone once a second (FM coin tick) + rare stat/card changes

scenarios.name: club_churn
scenarios.desc: same clubs with heavy inventory traffic: packs of 5, level ups, sales, stat changes every few frames

scenarios.name: club_join
scenarios.desc: one player per frame rejoins: full 300-card club snapshot replicated again

scenarios.name: match_shared
scenarios.desc: one shared match state (clock every frame, 4 staminas, score) replicated to all 50 clients
